new_math.name: Signed Re-arrangement Histograms for Quantized Dot Bounds
assumptions: weight and input positive shared scales constant within each joint K partition
new_math.theorem: Given two fixed sorted signed code multisets a<= and b<=, min sum a[i]b[reverse i], max sum a[i]b[i] across all alignments.
new_math.fact: tight with respect to per-block histograms alone; may be wide and full MHD/B group screening costly
new_math.quantization_limits: Actual original Wan HiF4 Q2 dynamic 64-to-8-to-4 closure, actual Q1 bit availability unverified
